mutations.label: 53c the intent check is dropped, so "undefined" reaches Goodreads' Exclusive Shelf
53d the intent is checked for being a string but not for being a real pile
53e a bad row THROWS the whole shelf away instead of being dropped
mutations.from: return raw.map(record).filter((s): s is SavedBook => s !== null);
mutations.to:
const rows = raw.map(record);
  return rows.some((s) => s === null) ? [] : (rows as SavedBook[]);

mutations.label: 53f a malformed OPTIONAL drops the whole book instead of being stripped
mutations.to:
const theSource = source(raw['source']);
  if (raw['source'] !== undefined && !theSource) return null;

mutations.label: 53g a stored javascript: source url is trusted again
53h optionals are written as undefined instead of omitted, which is TS-7's runtime half
53i the log stops checking that ms is finite, so one NaN poisons every mean
mutations.to: if (typeof raw['at'] !== 'number' || typeof raw['ms'] !== 'number') return null;

mutations.label: 53j the log stops checking the outcome, so an invented one skews the denominator
53k `oneOf` accepts anything, so every dimension check is vacuous
mutations.from:
const oneOf = (v: unknown, allowed: readonly string[]): boolean =>
  typeof v === 'string' && allowed.includes(v);
mutations.to:
const oneOf = (v: unknown, allowed: readonly string[]): boolean =>
  typeof v === 'string' && allowed.length > 0;

mutations.label: 53l readSettings stops calling the validator and hands back raw storage
53m readSettingsFrom spreads instead of validating, so apiKey can be a number
mutations.from:
if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null || Array.isArray(raw)) return DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
  const got = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
